name: Datacenter Münster Osnabrück (DMO)
developer: DMO GmbH / TKRZ Stadtwerke GmbH / items GmbH & Co. KG
notes: Located at Münster/Osnabrück Airport in Greven, Kreis Steinfurt. First phase opened 15 Apr 2026 after about one year of construction with about 1 MW IT load, roughly 500 sqm and 140 racks; sources cite EN 50600 VK3 security and PV-backed energy concept.

name: TKRZ regional data centers (Emsdetten, Greven, Rheine)
notes: TKRZ states it offers customer server/data hosting in its data centers in Emsdetten, Greven, Rheine and Nordhorn; the first three are in Kreis Steinfurt. City of Emsdetten reported the TKRZ data center opening with 20 new cabinets plus 18 existing cabinets, about 2,000 rack units total.

name: Elementmedia Schwerte data center
notes: Operator states it runs a modern secure data center in Schwerte for business customers, with alarm systems, electronic access control and high-availability operation. Schwerte is in Kreis Unna.

name: Systemec DC Nettetal
notes: Systemec describes a high-performance data center in Nettetal-West, linked with its Venlo data centers as cross-border infrastructure on separate power grids. Data Center Map lists the facility at An der Kleinbahn, 41334 Nettetal.

name: Kommunales Rechenzentrum Niederrhein (KRZN), Kamp-Lintfort
notes: Municipal data center headquartered/sited in Kamp-Lintfort, Kreis Wesel. KRZN serves municipal administrations including the districts of Kleve, Mettmann, Viersen and Wesel; SUSE case study confirms headquarters in Kamp-Lintfort and public-sector IT operation.

name: RZH Rechenzentrum für Heilberufe GmbH
notes: Healthcare IT and billing service provider headquartered at Am Schornacker 32, 46485 Wesel. Public sources confirm the Rechenzentrum fuer Heilberufe identity and Wesel site, but do not disclose facility power or colocation-style specifications.

name: tal.de Wuppertal data center
notes: tal.de states it operates modern Wuppertal data center space to Level-3 standard with green power, PUE about 1.2/under 1.3, over 1,500 sqm of data center area and 24/7 service. Data Center Map lists the Wuppertal facility at Uellendahler Str. 353 and cites 1.5 MW.

name: Digitalzentrum Ahrweiler
notes: Planned carrier-neutral digital infrastructure campus in Kreis Ahrweiler on an approximately 18,000 sqm brownfield site, with 5 MW available short-term and scaling to 20 MW in planning. Site is positioned between Frankfurt and Cologne/Düsseldorf with redundant dark-fiber routes planned.

name: DC IT ROOM Wallmenroth-Bruche Data Center
developer: DC IT ROOM / Data Center Group ecosystem
notes: Datacenters.com lists a carrier-neutral Wallmenroth-Bruche data center. Data Center Group primary/GDA pages confirm Wallmenroth as the headquarters and operating/services base for secure, highly available IT infrastructure, but facility-level capacity details were not found in primary sources.
